words.gloss: to take up together, i.e. settle accounts
to be at a loss, be perplexed
And He has done violence to
therefore He has caused to lament
to examine on all sides, to despise
and He has caused to rejoice
to those who wait for Him
to the one who strikes him
and yet He will show compassion
a breaking, fracture, crushing, breach, crash
an ethnarch, a governor (not king) of a province
a going around, continuance, still, yet, again, beside
to look out or about, spy, keep watch
so that we could not walk
